spec: Write csvjson.py with `convert(text: str) -> list[dict]` that parses RFC 4180 CSV text (header row first; quoted fields may contain commas, doubled quotes and newlines) into a list of dicts keyed by header. Infer each value's type: empty field -> None; true/false (any case) -> bool; integers without leading zeros (optional minus; "0" is fine) -> int; decimals/exponents like 3.5, -0.25, 1e3 -> float (the integer part must also have no leading zeros, so 007 or 00.5 stay str); everything else stays a str exactly as written (keep surrounding spaces). A quoted field is always a str ("" quoted -> empty string, not None). Raise ValueError if a row has a different number of fields than the header. Blank trailing line is ignored. Standard library only.
